messages.context: 进入道场挑战前，Tao 大师给予伤害保护
messages.raw: §eMaster Tao sees you getting ready to do the Dojo and grants you damage protection.
messages.text: Master Tao sees you getting ready to do the Dojo and grants you damage protection.
messages.gloss: 和旧版“as Master Tao's student”说明不同，这是实测的系统叙述写法。
messages.zh: Tao 大师见你要开始道场挑战，为你施加了伤害保护。

messages.context: 离开道场挑战前，Tao 大师撤去伤害保护
messages.raw: §eMaster Tao sees you getting ready to leave the Dojo and removes your protection.
messages.text: Master Tao sees you getting ready to leave the Dojo and removes your protection.
messages.gloss: 和旧版“protection dissipates”说明不同，这是实测的系统叙述写法。
messages.zh: Tao 大师见你准备离开道场，撤去了伤害保护。

messages.context: 挑战结算或装备要求时背包内没有腰带
messages.raw: §cYou don't have a belt in your inventory!
messages.text: You don't have a belt in your inventory!
messages.gloss: 这是系统错误提示，不翻译玩家背包中具体物品。

messages.context: 道场挑战期间尝试打开集市
messages.raw: §cYou cannot access the bazaar during a challenge.
messages.text: You cannot access the bazaar during a challenge.
messages.gloss: Bazaar 是交易功能，沿用集市译名。
messages.zh: 挑战期间无法使用集市。
